tree.heading: Commission
tree.text: The term “Commission” means the Rio Grande Natural Area Commission established by section 460rrr–2(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Natural Area
tree.text: The term “Natural Area” means the Rio Grande Natural Area established by section 460rrr–1(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 109–337, § 1, Oct. 12, 2006, 120 Stat. 1777, provided that: “This Act [enacting this subchapter] may be cited as the ‘Rio Grande Natural Area Act’.”
